tested_scope.model: finite deterministic symbolic reconstruction model with immutable artifacts g1->g2 and one mutable canonical pointer

designs.pair: readable atomic pointer (generation,target_digest); accept only when target exists, digest matches, and artifact-embedded generation equals pointer generation
designs.self_chain: pair plus predecessor_digest in pointer/artifact; accept only when predecessor field also matches the target artifact
designs.floor_guarded_self_chain: self_chain plus a trusted monotone generation floor reconstructed independently of the mutable canonical pointer; reject any pointer generation below that floor

torn_subcases: new generation paired with an older valid target digest
current target with corrupted predecessor field
tested_scope.trusted_floor_assumption: For floor_guarded_self_chain only, floor=2 is supplied by an immutable role-local witness outside the mutable pointer's rollback domain. How to reconstruct that witness safely is not proved in this slice.

probe_result: Pointer-local integrity and freshness are separable. Digest/generation cross-checking rejects mixed-field corruption, and predecessor self-chaining rejects predecessor corruption, but neither an atomic pair nor an internally self-consistent predecessor chain can distinguish a valid current snapshot from a replayed older valid snapshot. Reset/recreate-to-old and stale-old-valid are observationally equivalent to those pointer-local validators. A freshness guarantee therefore requires a monotone witness outside the mutable pointer rollback domain; if that witness or pointer is unreadable/unverifiable, the safe action is no write and cross-invocation continuation.
mechanism_revision: Retain one canonical atomic pointer for publication, but do not treat pointer self-consistency as proof of freshness. Separate integrity validation from freshness validation. Admission of a recovered pointer requires both a valid content/predecessor chain and a monotone floor independently reconstructed from immutable role-local generation evidence; unknown or incomplete witness reconstruction fails closed.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is conditional on the trusted monotone-floor assumption and only covers the enumerated two-generation symbolic traces. It does not prove safe floor reconstruction under namespace truncation, forked certificates, whole-namespace rollback, repository history rewrite, GC, rate-limit partial listing, non-CAS stores, or external irreversible effects.

mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: conditional logical result: local pointer integrity cannot certify freshness; floor-guarded chain rejects the tested old-valid replays when the monotone floor is trustworthy
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Construct and test a Chat-native monotone-floor witness from immutable role-local generation certificates under partial namespace listing, duplicate/forked certificates, rate-limit interruption, and certificate-set rollback/truncation.
